tagline: Know the size of the prize before you spend a pound chasing it
intro: We size markets, take competitors apart and listen to customers, then write it up as a report your board will read to the end. Every figure comes with its source and every claim with its working.
audience: Founders, strategy leads and investors at UK and Irish B2B software and fintech companies, from a first market entry to a Series B board pack.
pricing_note: A fixed fee per study, agreed before we start and paid in two halves. Most studies run four to eight weeks. Quarterly tracking is quoted as a retainer.

services.title: Market sizing
services.description: Top-down and bottom-up estimates of your total, reachable and winnable market, with every assumption written down so you can change one and see what moves.

services.title: Competitor teardowns
services.description: We sign up, buy, sit through sales calls and read the job ads of up to eight rivals, then lay out their pricing, positioning and gaps side by side.

services.title: Voice of the customer
services.description: Twenty to forty recorded interviews with buyers, churned accounts and lost deals, coded by theme, with the quotes that explain why people choose, stay or leave.

services.title: Market entry briefs
services.description: A short report on one new country or segment: who buys, who already sells, what it costs to get in, and what would make us tell you to wait.

process.title: Agree the question
process.description: One call to pin down the decision the research has to inform, the markets in scope and the date you need it by. It goes into a one-page brief you sign off.

process.title: Gather the evidence
process.description: Desk research, pricing pages, filings, expert calls and customer interviews, all logged in a source list that comes with the report.

process.title: Write the finding
process.description: A report that leads with the answer, shows the working behind every figure and ends with what we would do next. We present it live, then it is yours to keep.

proof.text: The first sizing model our board did not argue with, because every input was on the page.
proof.source: Chief executive, a London payments start-up (sample)

proof.text: Their teardown changed how we priced our middle tier.
proof.source: Head of product, a Dublin insurance platform (sample)

proof.text: Thirty interviews, one clear reason customers were leaving, and it was not the one we had guessed.
